source.basis: Publisher-identified GLORYS12V1 reanalysis; not direct daily observations

geometry_conventions.axis_heading: WGS84 inverse initial azimuth between tangent endpoints, applied at gate
geometry_conventions.boundary_interpolation: linear longitude/latitude, nominal 1km subdivision then40 root bisections
geometry_conventions.tangent_interpolation: WGS84 leg distance, linear longitude/latitude within source segment
